description: This file defines a custom exception class 'RecordNotFoundException' within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for API version 2, indicating a record was not found.

classes.name: RecordNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception class, used to signify that a requested record was not found within the API V2 context of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a default message, optional code, and previous throwable. It calls the parent Exception constructor.
